fieldValues.title: The programme as its own SRS repository
fieldValues.summary: The programme that reworks the specification is held as SRS records in programme/, with its own registered conformance check, rather than as issue prose. It doubles as the low-risk pilot for the concept-tree pattern before that pattern touches the 433-record spec corpus.
fieldValues.body: The definition layer — types phase, unit, finding and carried_context, the programme_unit lifecycle, and check-programme-conformance.mjs — merged in srs#583. The instance layer is the phases, units, findings, carried context and the contains/precedes/depends-on tree over them, and is what makes the pilot a proof rather than a schema.
